description: Set a media file's alt text (accessibility description). It belongs to the file, so one value covers every post that reuses it, and is sent to Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Tumblr and Discord. Pass an empty string to clear. Use this when the user wants to add or change an image's alt text / accessibility description.

altText.description: Description of the image for people who cannot see it. Empty string clears it.

name: update_media
title: Set media alt text
